title: SenseTime Officially Releases SenseNova 6.8 Flash, Focusing on Real-World Task Execution and Design Collaboration

content_html:
On November 3, SenseTime officially announced the launch of the official version of the "SenseNova" SenseNova6.8Flash model. As a new-generation multimodal agent model built for real-world complex environments, this version focuses on core pain points in task execution and delivery, and has achieved significant breakthroughs in long-term memory, proactive interaction, and cross-task collaboration.

In real-world application scenarios, SenseNova6.8Flash demonstrates stronger multi-dimensional implementation capabilities:

Office collaboration: The model deeply strengthens long-term memory and cross-session collaboration, effectively solving the problem of information gaps when users handle cross-stage, long-cycle projects. Whether it is continuously retaining and accurately following up on relevant customer information, or accumulating long-term role-specific business experience, it provides robust foundational support.

Design and creation: The model comprehensively expands the forms of generation and delivery. It not only supports multiple creative types such as static web pages and dynamic content, but also innovatively supports dynamic PPT and Agentic3D design. More importantly, it can deeply integrate with mainstream design and workflow tools such as Figma, helping creators seamlessly incorporate AI capabilities into their existing professional design ecosystems.

Industry analysts point out that with the debut of the official version of SenseNova6.8Flash, SenseTime is accelerating the evolution of large models from simple "content generation" to "multimodal agents" that can autonomously plan, call tools, and complete final delivery, bringing more efficient productivity transformation to enterprises and individual users.
